metadata.caption: Outline of the results. The main theoretical results of this article are presented here, along with the Assumptions they rely on. The dependence on the assumptions are indicated using thin grey arrows, while the logical dependencies of the main results are indicated y thick lack arrows. The Corollaries provide the most recognizable consequences of such eigenfunctions.

nodes.name: A:A1: Assumption
nodes.statement: $M$ is an $n$-dimensional $C^1$ manifold equipped with the the Borel $\sigma$-algebra $\mathcal{B}$. $\Phi^t$ is a $C^1$ flow on $M$ generated by a vector field $V$. The flow has an invariant probability measure $\mu$ with a compact support $X\subset M$.

nodes.name: A:z: Assumption
nodes.statement: $z:X\to S^1$ is a non-constant, $C(X)$ or $L^2(\mu)$ eigenfunction with eigenfrequency $\omega$. Let the partition created by its level sets be denoted as $\mathcal{F}$, similar to (7). Set $\mathcal{L}_1$ to be the leaf $\mathcal{F}_{0} \equiv z^{-1}(1)$.

nodes.name: A:generating: Assumption
nodes.statement: The quasiperiodicity dimension $\dim_{\mathcal{D}}$ is finite. In other words the set $\mathcal{D}$ from (4) is generated by $\dim_{\mathcal{D}}$ independent eigenfunctions $z_1,\ldots,z_{\dim_{\mathcal{D}}}$, for some $\dim_{\mathcal{D}}\geq 1$.

nodes.name: thm:fol_1D_basic: -- Partitions from the leaves of a Koopman eigenfunction their conditional measure…
nodes.statement:
Let Assumptions A:A1 and A:z hold. Then for every $\theta\in [0,2\pi)$,
\begin{enumerate}[(i)]
	\item $\Phi^t$ maps the fibre $\mathcal{F}_\theta$ homeomorphically onto the fibre $\mathcal{F}_{\theta+\omega t \bmod 2\pi}$. 
	\item The images $\Phi^{2\pi t/\omega}(\mathcal{F}_\theta)$ are disjoint, for $0\leq t<1$, and their union is the whole set $X$.
	\item $\Phi^t_{*}\left(\mu|\mathcal{F}_{\theta}\right)$ = $\mu|\mathcal{F}_{\theta+\omega t \bmod 2\pi}$.
	\item The following map $\Psi$ is a continuous bijection.
	
	\begin{equation}	
	\Psi : \mathcal{L}_1 \times [0,1)\to X; \quad \Psi(y,t) := \Phi^{t \cdot 2\pi/\omega} y
	\end{equation}
	
	Moreover $\Psi$ transforms the product measure $\left(\mu | \mathcal{L}_1\right)\times \mbox{Leb}$ into the invariant measure $\mu$. 
	\item If $z$ was an $L^2(\mu)$ eigenfunction instead, then these claims are true upto a set of $\mu$-measure $0$.
\end{enumerate}

nodes.name: thm:fol_1D_basemap: -- Return map suspension flow over base leaf
thm:fol_1D_return: -- Ergodic properties of the return map
nodes.statement:
Let Assumptions A:A1, A:z and A:generating hold, and  $R : \mathcal{L}_1 \to \mathcal{L}_1$ be the return map from Theorem thm:fol_1D_basemap. Then
\begin{enumerate}[(i)]
	\item The discrete subspace ($\mathcal{D}$ from  4) of $R : \mathcal{L}_1 \to \mathcal{L}_1$ is generated by $\dim_{\mathcal{D}}-1$ eigenfunctions.
	
	Henceforth assume that $\dim_{\mathcal{D}}=1$. In that case,
	\item $R :  \mathcal{L}_1 \to \mathcal{L}_1$ has no eigenfunctions and hence is weakly mixing.
	\item $U^t | \mathcal{D}^\bot$ is strongly / weakly mixing iff $R$ is strongly / weakly mixing, in which case, these two systems have the same rates of mixing.
\end{enumerate}

nodes.name: thm:fol_1D_flow: -- Restriction of the flow to the base leaf
thm:fol_1D_flow_eig: -- Restriction of the flow to the base leaf
nodes.statement:
Under the same assumptions and notations of Theorem~thm:fol_1D_flow, we further have
    \begin{enumerate} [(i)]
        \item Let $\tilde{\mu}$ be an invariant measure for  $\tilde{\Phi}^t$ restricted to $\mathcal{L}$. Then for every $t\in [0,2\pi/\omega)$, $\Phi^t_* \tilde{\mu}$ will be an invariant measure for  $\tilde{\Phi}^t$ restricted to the leaf $ \Phi^t \left( \mathcal{L} \right)$.
        \item  Let $\tilde{\zeta}$ be an $L^2(\tilde{\mu})$ eigenfunction with eigenfrequency $\omega'$, for the flow $\tilde{\Phi}^t|_{\mathcal{L}}$. Then its extension 
        
        \[ \zeta \left(  \Psi(y,s)  \right) := e^{\iota 2\pi s} \tilde{\zeta}(y), \quad \forall y\in \mathcal{L}_1, \quad \forall s\in [0,1) . \]
        
        is an eigenfunction of $V$ with eigenfrequency $\omega'+\omega$.
        \item Suppose Assumption A:z_multple holds. Then the metric $\tau$ may be chosen so that $\tilde{V}(z_j) = \iota \omega_j z_j$, for $j=1,\ldots,d$.
    \end{enumerate}

nodes.name: thm:Main: -- Main result
nodes.statement:
Let Assumptions A:A1 and A:z_multple hold, and for every $k\in \left\{  1, \ldots, d \right\}$, $\pi^{(k)}$, $\mathcal{F}^{(k)}$ and $\mathcal{L}_k$ be as defined above, $\mu_k$ be as in (14),  let $V_k$ be the vector fields in (15), $\Phi_k^t$ be the associated flow, and $R_k$ be the return maps from (16). Then for each $k$ in $\left\{ 1, \ldots, d \right\}$,

\begin{enumerate}[(i)]
    \item $V_k$ is tangent to the foliation $\mathcal{F}^{(k)}$.
    \item $V_k z_j = 0$ if $1\leq j<k$,  and $V_k z_j = i \omega_j z_j$ if $k\leq j\leq d$, .
	\item The leaf $\mathcal{L}_{k-1}$ is invariant under $\Phi_k$, i.e.,  $\Phi_k^t:\mathcal{L}_{k-1} \to \mathcal{L}_{k-1}$ is a $C^1$ flow. Moreover, $\Phi_k^{2\pi/\omega_k}:\mathcal{L}_{k} \to \mathcal{L}_{k}$.
	\item The map $\Psi^{(k)}$ defined below is a $C^1$ bijection.
	\begin{equation} 
		\Psi^{(k)}:\mathcal{L}_k\times [0,1)^k \to M; \quad (x,t_1,\ldots,t_k) \mapsto \Phi_{1}^{2\pi t_1/ \omega_k} \cdots \Phi_{k}^{2\pi t_k/ \omega_k} x,
	\end{equation}
	\item The push-forward measure $\Psi^{(k)}_*(\mu_k \times \mbox{Leb}^k)$ coincides with $\mu$.
	
	\item Suppose in addition, Assumption A:generating holds with $\dim_{\mathcal{D}} = d$. Then $R_d: \mathcal{L}_d \to \mathcal{L}_d$ is weakly mixing. Moreover, $R_d$ has the same spectral measure as $U^t | \mathcal{D}^\bot$. In particular, $R_d$ is strongly mixing iff $U^t | \mathcal{D}^\bot$ is, in which case they have the same rates of mixing.
\end{enumerate}

nodes.name: corr:spectral_charac: -- Characterization of the quasiperiodic chaotic components of the spectrum
nodes.statement: Let Assumptions A:A1 and A:z_multple hold, and consider the form (6) claimed by Corollary corr:skew. If in addition Assumption A:generating holds, then $\mathcal{D}$ and $\mathcal{D}^\bot$ respectively corresponds to the functions dependent only on the $\theta$ and $y$ variables respectively.

nodes.name: corr:skew: -- Skew product structure of the dynamics with toral rotations as drivers
nodes.statement: Let Assumptions A:A1 and A:z_multple hold. Then under a change of variables, the flow takes the form of a quasiperiodically driven dynamics (6).
